REPORT
Date March 5, 1936.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / File No. S. B. D. 5721 / REGISTERED / - 36.）
Subject Professor Ho Tsung Ya alias Asia Ho Dzing Ya (何震亞).
Made by D.I. Kuh Pao Hwa Forwarded by D.S.Rno. D.I.
Professor Ho Tsung Ya alias Asia Ho Dzing Ya,
particulars of whose movements were once requested by the
local Netherlands Consulate (Vide File D-5721) is at
present holding the following posts: Principal of the
"Chinese Supplementary School for Foreigners" (外国人补习学校);
Head of the "Association of Chinese and Foreign Cultural
Relations" (中外文化协会) and Proprietor of the "China & Foreign
Tourist Guiding Bureau" (中外游历指导所). The offices of these
three organs are located in Room 330, 749 Bubbling Well
Road. Copies of the prospectus, Enrollement card and
regulations of these enterprises which are printed in
English are attached herewith.
The monthly rental of the offices which were leased
by Professor Ho, some 6 months ago, from the Tung Yuen (通元)
Rent Agency, 749 Bubbling Well Road, is $34. The Chinese
Supplementary School for Foreigners has an enrollment of
about twenty pupils.
（批：S2. Please inform Netherlands Consulate. JAG 5 MAR 1936）
（批：Kuh Pao hwa D. I.）
（批：D.C. (Special Branch) Instructions carried out by S.S. Jones. DSR 6 3/4..）

日期：1936年3月5日。

事由：何宗亚教授，又名 Asia Ho Dzing Ya（何震亞）。
呈报人：督察 顾宝华 转呈人：副督察长 [签名] 督察。
何宗亚教授，又名 Asia Ho Dzing Ya，其行踪细节曾由荷兰驻沪领事馆查询（见档案 D-5721），目前担任以下职务：“外国人补习学校”校长；“中外文化协会”会长；以及“中外游历指导所”业主。这三个机构的办事处均位于静安寺路749号330室。随函附上这些机构用英文印刷的章程、报名卡及规章副本。
何教授于约6个月前从静安寺路749号通元（Tung Yuen）租赁行租下该办事处，月租金为34元。外国人补习学校现有学生约二十名。
（批：S2. 请通知荷兰领事馆。JAG 1936年3月5日）
（批：顾宝华 督察）
（批：D.C. (特科) 指示已由 S.S. Jones 执行。DSR 6 3/4..）

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY. File No. 5721 Date 22/3/34）

Subject (in full) Ho Tsung-ya alias Asia Ho Dzing Ya (何宗亞).

Made by and Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao Liang.

Enquiries at Nanking show that the man Asia
Ho Dzing Ya is not the brother of Gen. Ho Ying Ching but
is known as a political adventurer.
The Nanking Authorities do not suspect him of being
a communist and have paid little attention to his movements.

Tan Shaoliang
Superintendent.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
CONFIDENTIAL
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY. No. 5721 Ds）
S.2.
Date 17.1.34 134
Subject (in full) Enquiry from Netherlands Consulate-General respecting Professor Asia Ho Dzin Ya.
Made by D.S. Jones Forwarded by （签名）
Enquiries made by the undersigned regarding Professor Ho Tsung Ya (何震亞), as he describes himself on the visiting card enclosed in the letter concerning him from the Netherlands Consulate-General, or Professor Asia Ho Dzin Ya, as the Chinese Secretary for the Consul-General for the Netherlands describes him, show that he has already made himself acquainted with leading Hungarians in Shanghai.
In making enquiries about this individual I visited on March 16 Drs Renner and Lusztig at their place of business in the Sassoon Building. From Dr Renner I learned that Professor Ho had been invited by him to attend a private function at his residence, No.2 Daybrook Estate, Tunsin Road on March 15, in celebration of a Hungarian national holiday which fell on the latter date.
During the course of the evening Professor Ho delivered a short speech in German dealing with his project of forming in Shanghai a Hungarian Chinese Society, the object of which would be the promotion of good will between China and Hungary. Ho is reported to have been Vice-President of a similar organisation in Budapest and to have come here with references from Hungarian personalities of that city.
Whether or not Ho is a relative of General Ho Ying-chi, Minister of War in Nanking, as he declares himself to be, is not yet known.
（批：Klc）
Professor Ho, who has been residing for a time in Nanking, returned to Shanghai for the especial purpose of attending the function at Dr Renner's home. We have so far been unable to ascertain Ho's local address, but his address in Nanking is given as :

机密
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 C. & S. B. 登记处。编号 5721 Ds）
S.2.
日期：1934年1月17日 134
事由（全称）：荷兰总领事馆关于 Asia Ho Dzin Ya 教授的查询。
制作人：副督察 Jones 呈报人：（签名）
经卑职对何宗亚教授（何震亞）进行调查——其在荷兰总领事馆有关他的来信所附名片上自称为此名，或如荷兰总领事馆中文秘书所称之 Asia Ho Dzin Ya 教授——结果显示，他已与在沪的主要匈牙利人士建立联系。
在调查此人期间，我于3月16日前往沙逊大厦 Drs Renner 和 Lusztig 的办公处拜访了他们。从 Renner 博士处获悉，何教授曾受其邀请，于3月15日参加其在敦信路（Tunsin Road）戴布鲁克公寓（Daybrook Estate）2号寓所举行的私人活动，以庆祝适逢当日的匈牙利国庆日。
当晚，何教授发表了一篇简短的德语演讲，内容涉及他在上海组建一个匈中协会的计划，该协会的宗旨是促进中国与匈牙利之间的友好关系。据称，何曾在布达佩斯担任类似组织的副主席，并持有该市匈牙利知名人士的推荐信来到此处。
何是否如其自称那样，是南京军政部长何应钦将军的亲属，目前尚不清楚。
（批：Klc）
何教授此前在南京居住了一段时间，此次返回上海是专门为了参加 Renner 博士家中的活动。截至目前，我们尚未查明何在沪的地址，但其在南京的地址列为：

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 679.

CONFIDENTIEEL

SHANGHAI. 5 March 1934.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY. No. D 5721 Date. 7 / 3 / 34）

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that there recently arrived here from Europe a Chinese by the name of Professor Asia Ho Dzin Ya whose card I enclose herewith.

Professor Ho spent, he says, the last seven years in Europe and was also frequently in Budapest where, I understand, he lectured at the University and acted as assistant to Professor Proehle.

In this connection, he was instrumental in the formation of a "Hungarian-Chinese Society" and the object of this Society is to promote mutual acquaintance and understanding of the Hungarian and Chinese peoples.

Professor Ho appears to be a very enthusiastic admirer of the Hungarian Nation and has, as he told others, recently lectured in Nanking on the subject of Hungary at the University there and also in Government circles.

Professor Ho intends now to form a Hungarian Chinese Society in Shanghai and in view of this I would be much obliged to receive some information, if possible, concerning this person.

He states to be a native of Hangchow and to be a relative of General Ho Ying-chi, Minister of War in Nanking. He makes the appearance of belonging to the poor student class.

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your obedient servant,

（签名）

Chinese Secretary
for Consul-General for the
Netherlands, temporarily in
charge of Hungarian Interests.

T. P. Givens, Esquire,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

（手写批注：Spoke to Ashton. S2, Fung Yang and telephoned Cons. general. 7/3/34）

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 C. & S. B. 登记处。编号 D 5721 日期. 7 / 3 / 34）

先生：

谨此奉告，近期有一位名为 Asia Ho Dzin Ya 教授的中国人从欧洲抵达此处，随函附上其名片。

据 Ho 教授称，他在欧洲度过了过去七年，并经常前往布达佩斯，据我了解，他在那里大学任教并担任 Proehle 教授的助手。

在此背景下，他促成了“匈中协会”的成立，该协会的宗旨是促进匈牙利人民与中国人民之间的相互了解和理解。

Ho 教授似乎是一位对匈牙利民族充满热情的仰慕者，并如他告诉他人那样，最近在南京的大学及政府圈内就匈牙利主题进行了演讲。

Ho 教授现在打算在上海组建一个匈中协会，鉴于此，如能提供一些关于此人的信息，我将不胜感激。

他声称自己是杭州人，并且是南京军政部长何应钦将军的亲属。他给人的印象是属于贫困学生阶层。

谨此致意，

先生，

您顺从的仆人，

（签名）

中文秘书
代荷兰总领事
暂管匈牙利利益事务。

T. P. Givens 先生，
特科主管警官，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

（手写批注：已与 Ashton 交谈。S2，冯洋并致电总领事馆。1934年3月7日）
